deviations_from_adr: Spec/ADR combined into T-0626.spec.md only (no separate .adr.md) — per task instruction and the T-0635 precedent, this is a small, well-scoped UX defect fix, not an architectural decision warranting a separate ADR.

Extracted the label-derivation logic into a new pure function resolveCardLabel (web/src/screens/kanban-board.js) instead of inlining deriveRecordLabel directly inside the KanbanCard JSX component. Reason: KanbanCard calls useCallback (a React hook), and this repo's web vitest tier is hook-free/jsdom-free (no react-test-renderer/react-dom available — confirmed by grepping the existing test suite and by a failed spike: calling KanbanCard as a plain function throws 'Cannot read properties of null (reading useCallback)'). Extracting the label VALUE computation into a pure, dependency-injected function makes the T-0626 fallback contract genuinely unit-testable (kanban-card-label.test.js) without adding a new test-rendering dependency to the project — mirrors the project's own established convention (buildKanbanColumns/buildMovePayload already live in kanban-board.js for the same reason, per that file's own header comment).

defect_and_fix.defect: web/src/screens/kanban-board.jsx, function KanbanCard, variable cardLabel: when a kanban view's card_fields was not configured (fields.length === 0), the card's aria-label / keyboard-select label fell back to a raw (truncated) UUID: `Запись ${record.id.slice(0, 8)}`. Live-proven user-facing defect, first surfaced by capstone T-0584 (LIVE_PROOF /poehali wave 2): an owner who never opens the kanban config panel sees cards labelled by opaque ids, not by any recognizable field of the record.
defect_and_fix.fix: The platform already has a canonical convention for exactly this situation — deriveRecordLabel (web/src/screens/records-form.js:1079-1089, T-0447): first non-empty string/number value found in record.data (schema-key order), or a short 8-char id ref (never a bare full UUID) if the record has no textual field at all. It is already reused by RelationCell/RelationPicker (forms/field-renderer.jsx) and by the record list and record detail screens (screen-app-records.jsx, screen-record-detail.jsx) — three independent consumers, zero duplication. kanban-board.jsx now imports and threads deriveRecordLabel into a new pure resolveCardLabel (kanban-board.js), which is called from KanbanCard for the empty-card_fields branch. The configured card_fields path (fields.length > 0) is completely untouched — same fields[0]-driven rendering and same pre-existing point fallback as before.

default_label_logic: When card_fields is empty: resolveCardLabel(record, [], ...) -> deriveRecordLabel(record) -> first non-empty string/number value in record.data (schema-key iteration order), else a short id ref (`${id.slice(0,8)}…`) — never the raw full UUID and never the old 'Запись <uuid>' template. When card_fields is configured: unchanged v1 behaviour — fields[0]'s rendered value via formatCellValue/computeComputedFieldValue, with its own pre-existing point fallback (`Запись ${id.slice(0,8)}`) only if that SPECIFIC configured field renders to a non-string for that record (out of scope for this fix, per spec FR-2).

tests_added.covers: Behavioural coverage of resolveCardLabel (pure function, no React/hooks needed): AC-2 empty card_fields + a non-empty string field -> that field's value, not a UUID/'Запись <id>' (2 cases, different field keys/ids); defensive case for cardFields=undefined treated like []; AC-3 configured card_fields path unchanged (fields[0] wins over deriveRecordLabel, including its own pre-existing point-fallback '—' when the configured field renders to a non-string); AC-4 record with zero textual/numeric fields -> deriveRecordLabel's own short-id-ref format ('cf1e4523…'), never the bare full UUID and never 'Запись <uuid>' — including a whitespace-only-string edge case.

Source-text/wiring proof (project convention for this hook-bearing JSX file, mirrors the rest of this test file): kanban-board.jsx imports deriveRecordLabel from records-form.js and resolveCardLabel from kanban-board.js; cardLabel is computed via resolveCardLabel with the correct argument order/threading; kanban-board.js's resolveCardLabel source itself returns deriveRecordLabelFn(record) on the empty-fields branch and is exported.

live_proof_plan: 1. On the dev stand, open an app with a kanban-type view whose card_fields is empty/unconfigured (either a fresh kanban view just created via the type picker, or an existing one where the owner never opened 'Настроить список' -> card fields).

2. Expected BEFORE this fix: every card on the board is labelled with a raw id fragment, e.g. 'Запись cf1e4523' (aria-label, and the 'Переместить «...» в колонку' select label) — no relation to any actual field of the record.

3. Expected AFTER this fix: every card's label (aria-label on the Card, and the keyboard-select's aria-label) shows the record's own first non-empty text/number field (e.g. a name/title-like field) — a human reads the board and can tell which record is which without opening it. A record with genuinely no textual field anywhere falls back to a short id reference (8 chars + ellipsis), still readable/copyable, never a bare 36-char UUID and never the old template text.

4. Regression check: a kanban view WITH card_fields configured (e.g. via 'Настроить список') is visually identical to before this change — same field(s) shown, same order, no new fallback text introduced.
5. Screenshot/snapshot both states (empty card_fields -> readable label; configured card_fields -> unchanged) as the LIVE_PROOF artifact for UX_REVIEW.
